segments.name: Las Vegas
segments.description: Owns and operates casino resorts in Las Vegas, offering gaming, hotel rooms, dining and entertainment to visiting casino and non-casino guests.
segments.evidence: In addition, hotel occupancy, which is the average percentage of available hotel rooms occupied during a period, is a key indicator for our hotel business in the Las Vegas segment.

segments.name: Regional
segments.description: Operates casino properties in regional markets across the United States, offering gaming, hotel, dining and entertainment to local casino guests.
segments.evidence: Our principal operating activities occur in four reportable segments: (1) Las Vegas, (2) Regional, (3) Caesars Digital, and (4) Managed and Branded, in addition to Corporate and Other.

segments.name: Caesars Digital
segments.description: Runs online sports betting, horse race wagering and iGaming apps for customers in North American jurisdictions where such wagering is legalized.
segments.evidence: We expect to continue to grow our operations in the Caesars Digital segment as new jurisdictions legalize retail and online sports betting and iGaming.

segments.name: Managed and Branded
segments.description: Collects fees for managing other hotels and casinos in North America and for licensing the Caesars brands and marks to third parties.
segments.evidence: Our principal operating activities occur in four reportable segments: (1) Las Vegas, (2) Regional, (3) Caesars Digital, and (4) Managed and Branded, in addition to Corporate and Other.

revenueModel.text: Guests and online customers pay the company for gaming, hotel stays, food and beverage, entertainment and its branded sports betting and iGaming apps.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary source of revenue is generated by our gaming operations, which includes our casino properties, retail and online sports betting and online gaming.

changes.text: The World Series of Poker brand was sold in 2024, with the company keeping a licensing agreement for its use.
changes.evidence: We continue to leverage the World Series of Poker ("WSOP") brand within the United States with the licensing agreement that we entered into concurrently with the sale of the WSOP brand on October 29, 2024.

changes.text: The LINQ Promenade was sold in 2024.
changes.evidence: On December 12, 2024, we sold the LINQ Promenade, which was an open-air dining, entertainment, and retail development located between The LINQ Hotel & Casino and Flamingo Las Vegas.

changes.text: The Rio-All Suite Hotel & Casino was divested at the end of the third quarter of 2023.
changes.evidence: Rio-All Suite Hotel & Casino which was divested at the end of the third quarter of 2023.
